topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its learning objectives regarding cancer therapies.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies, cytotoxicity, and drug resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine conventional local and systemic cancer therapies and the general challenges of non-specific cytotoxicity and drug resistance.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic cellular vulnerabilities and synthetic lethality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic molecular vulnerabilities, checkpoint deficiencies, and impaired DNA repair in cancer cells.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the therapeutic inhibition of hyperactive oncogenic kinases and the molecular mechanisms that lead to drug resistance and addiction.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe antibody-based strategies designed to selectively block cell signaling, recruit immune effector functions, or deliver cytotoxic payloads to tumor cells.

topics.label: Cancer immunology and cellular immunotherapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the harnessing of antitumor immunity through natural immune surveillance, immune checkpoint inhibition, and engineered T-cell therapies.

topics.label: Broader challenges, historical progress, and future directions in oncology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the overall trajectory of cancer management by examining clinical trial hurdles, historical survival gains, and emerging therapeutic paradigms.
